label: 038 post-hoc addition: Ridge regression, the linear benchmark for the learned tier
status: POST-HOC: added after the 038 verdicts were read (dcc4f2b9), at the user's request, as the honest linear counterpart to LightGBM (TSPredict's default PassiveAggressive ignores errors under epsilon=1.5 and has no intercept). Rule, costs, folds, training rows and scorer unchanged from preregistration.json; verdicts labelled post-hoc.

ridge_L.params: sklearn Ridge(alpha=1.0, fit_intercept=True) on features standardised with a StandardScaler fitted on each fit's training rows only (Principle XI); same anchored training span, purge, stride-4 rows and row filters as lgb_L
ridge_L.seed: deterministic: a seed-2 rerun is identical by construction, so condition (e) is met by the seed-1 run
